description.value: The Bakehouse is a neighbourhood bakery-café in West Vancouver's Dundarave village, known for house-baked breads — herb sourdough, Irish soda bread, focaccia — that anchor an all-day breakfast and hot sandwich menu. Cyclists on Marine Drive or the seawall will find it a solid stop for a substantial hot meal in a smoke-free, indoor-seating environment. The 'Dundarave' branding and varied scratch-cooked menu suggest a long-standing local fixture rather than a chain outlet.
